paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimations in different token decoding temperature . Right: Influence of token decoding temperature on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between decoding temperature and uncertainty estimations. The x-axis represents decoding temperature, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents an unspecified metric, with a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.175 and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.025. The plot features three lines: AU (red), TU (blue), and EU (green). The EU line is flat, remaining constant at 0.000 across the x-axis, with no markers. The AU and TU lines start at approximately 0.125 at a decoding temperature of 0.0, decrease slightly to around 0.120 at 0.4, then increase steadily to about 0.185 at 0.8; both lines have circular markers and a solid line style, with the AU line being red and the TU line being blue.
